description: Crushed stone base, bedding sand and the excavation depth under a paver patio, driveway or street, with the minimum base thickness for each traffic class read off a masonry association's own application guide. Estimate only; confirm with your plans, supplier and local code.

base.description: Base. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Shown on the site only when "shape=triangle" is set.

baseDensity.description: Density of the base aggregate your supplier sells: lb per cubic yard (imperial) or kg per cubic metre (metric). No default: without it no base tonnage is given.

baseDepth.description: Aggregate base depth. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 10cm.

beddingDensity.description: Density of the bedding sand your supplier sells: lb per cubic yard (imperial) or kg per cubic metre (metric). No default: without it no bedding tonnage or bag count is given.

beddingDepth.description: Bedding sand depth. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 2.5cm.

diameter.description: Diameter. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Shown on the site only when "shape=circle" is set.

height.description: Height (perpendicular to the base). Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Shown on the site only when "shape=triangle" is set.

length.description: Length. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 3.6. Shown on the site only when "shape=rectangle" is set.

paverThickness.description: Paver thickness. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: . Optional.

priceBaseTon.description: Base price per ton. Unit: $ / ton (imperial) or $ / t (metric). Optional.

priceBeddingTon.description: Bedding price per ton. Unit: $ / ton (imperial) or $ / t (metric). Optional.

system.description: Unit system the inputs are typed in and the defaults are taken from.

truck.description: Truck capacity. Unit: cu yd (imperial) or m³ (metric). Optional.

width.description: Width. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 3.6. Shown on the site only when "shape=rectangle" is set.
